profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is the Information Systems Facility at White Sands Missile Range, a large United States Army test and evaluation installation in south central New Mexico. Official US Army news coverage documents groundbreaking on August 24, 2021 for the 56,268 square foot, two story facility, built to replace a telephone and administrative network core building dating to 1962 and to consolidate networking, communications, data processing, Land Mobile Radio control, and IT support functions previously spread across multiple older buildings on the installation. The project cost approximately 70.6 million dollars in total, about 53 million dollars for construction and 17.6 million dollars for equipment, described by Army officials as the first major military construction project at White Sands Missile Range in nearly two decades, with construction projected for completion in December 2023. As a military installation facility supporting range operations, testing, and communications, no third party capacity or colocation information exists for it. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.

reading: White Sands Missile Range, a large United States Army test and evaluation installation in south central New Mexico, broke ground on August 24, 2021, for a new Information Systems Facility, according to official US Army news coverage. The 56,268 square foot, two story facility was built to replace a telephone and administrative network core building dating to 1962 and to consolidate networking, communications, data processing, Land Mobile Radio control, and IT support functions previously spread across multiple older buildings on the installation. The project cost approximately 70.6 million dollars in total, with about 53 million dollars for construction and 17.6 million dollars for equipment, and Army officials described it as the first major military construction project at White Sands Missile Range in nearly two decades. Construction was projected for completion in December 2023. As a military installation facility supporting range operations, testing, and communications rather than a commercial or public facing entity, no third party capacity or colocation information exists for this facility, and the specifics reported here come directly from the Army's own public affairs coverage of the project.
